```
1. <?php
2. 
3. namespace App\Models;
4. 
5. use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
6. use Illuminate\Support\Str;
7. 
8. class Event extends Model
9. {
10.     protected $primaryKey = 'id_event';
11.     public $incrementing = false;
12.     protected $keyType = 'string';
13. 
14.     protected $fillable = [
15.         'id_event',
16.         'id_org',
17.         'nama_event',
18.         'kategori',
19.         'tgl_mulai',
20.         'status'
21.     ];
22. 
23.     protected $appends = ['progress', 'financial_summary'];
24. 
25.     protected static function boot()
26.     {
27.         parent::boot();
28. 
29.         static::creating(function ($model) {
30.             if (!$model->id_event) {
31.                 $model->id_event = (string) Str::uuid();
32.             }
33.         });
34. 
35.         // ✅ AUTO STATUS UPDATE
36.         static::saving(function ($event) {
37.             if ($event->tgl_mulai <= now() && $event->status === 'planning') {
38.                 $event->status = 'ongoing';
39.             }
40.         });
41.     }
42. 
43.     // RELATIONS
44.     public function organization()
45.     {
46.         return $this->belongsTo(\App\Models\Organization::class, 'id_org', 'id_org');
47.     }
48. 
49.     public function committees()
50.     {
51.         return $this->hasMany(\App\Models\EventCommittee::class, 'id_event', 'id_event');
52.     }
53.     public function tasks()
54.     {
55.         return $this->hasMany(Task::class, 'id_event');
56.     }
57. 
58.     public function budgets()
59.     {
60.         return $this->hasMany(EventBudget::class, 'id_event');
61.     }
62. 
63.     public function expenses()
64.     {
65.         return $this->hasMany(ExpenseReport::class, 'id_event');
66.     }
67. 
68.     
69.     // ✅ PROGRESS
70.     public function getProgressAttribute()
71.     {
72.         $total = $this->tasks()->count();
73.         $done = $this->tasks()->where('status', 'done')->count();
74. 
75.         return $total ? round(($done / $total) * 100) : 0;
76.     }
77. 
78.     // ✅ FINANCIAL SUMMARY
79.     public function getFinancialSummaryAttribute()
80.     {
81.         $budget = $this->budgets()->sum('sub_total');
82.         $expense = $this->expenses()->sum('sub_total');
83. 
84.         return [
85.             'total_budget' => $budget,
86.             'total_expense' => $expense,
87.             'remaining' => $budget - $expense,
88.         ];
89.     }
90. }
```

```
3. namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;
4. 
5. use App\Models\Task;

7. use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;

11. use App\Http\Requests\UpdateTaskRequest;
12. 
13. class TaskController extends Controller
14. {
15.     public function index(Request $request)
16.     {
17.         $query = Task::with(['division', 'assignee']);
18. 
19.         if ($request->id_event) {
20.             $query->where('id_event', $request->id_event);
21.         }
22. 
23.         return TaskResource::collection($query->get());
24.     }
25. 
26.     public function store(StoreTaskRequest $request)
27.     {
28.         $user = auth()->user();
29. 
30.         // 🔥 COMBINE RBAC LOGIC
31.         if (
32.             !$user->isSuperAdmin() &&
33.             !$user->isEventLeader($request->id_event)
34.         ) {
35.             return response()->json([
36.                 'message' => 'Only leader or admin can create task'
37.             ], 403);
38.         }
39. 
40.         $committee = EventCommittee::where('id_event', $request->id_event)
41.             ->where('id_divisi', $request->id_divisi)
42.             ->first();
43. 
44.         $task = Task::create([
45.             ...$request->validated(),
46.             'assigned_to' => $committee?->id_user
47.         ]);
48. 
49.         return new TaskResource($task);
50.     }
51. 
52.     public function show($id)
53.     {
54.         return new TaskResource(
55.             Task::with(['division', 'assignee'])->findOrFail($id)
56.         );
57.     }
58. 
59.     public function update(UpdateTaskRequest $request, $id)
60.     {
61.         $task = Task::findOrFail($id);
62.         $user = auth()->user();
63. 
64.         // 🔥 RBAC: hanya assignee atau leader/admin
65.         if (
66.             $task->assigned_to !== $user->id_user &&
67.             !$user->isSuperAdmin() &&
68.             !$user->isEventLeader($task->id_event)
69.         ) {
70.             return response()->json([
71.                 'message' => 'Not allowed to update this task'
72.             ], 403);
73.         }
74. 
75.         $task->update($request->validated());
76. 
77.         return new TaskResource($task);
78.     }
79. 
80.     public function destroy($id)
81.     {
82.         $task = Task::findOrFail($id);
83.         $user = auth()->user();
84. 
85.         // 🔥 hanya admin / leader
86.         if (
87.             !$user->isSuperAdmin() &&
88.             !$user->isEventLeader($task->id_event)
89.         ) {
90.             return response()->json([
91.                 'message' => 'Not allowed to delete this task'
92.             ], 403);
93.         }
94. 
95.         $task->delete();
96. 
97.         return response()->json(['message' => 'Deleted']);
98.     }
99. 
100.     public function kanban($eventId)
101.     {
102.         $tasks = Task::where('id_event', $eventId)
103.             ->get()
104.             ->groupBy('status');
105. 
106.         return response()->json([
107.             'todo' => TaskResource::collection($tasks['todo'] ?? []),
108.             'progress' => TaskResource::collection($tasks['progress'] ?? []),
109.             'done' => TaskResource::collection($tasks['done'] ?? []),
110.         ]);
111.     }
112. }
```

```
10. 
11. class User extends Authenticatable
12. {
13.     use HasApiTokens;
14. 
15.     protected $primaryKey = 'id_user';
16.     public $incrementing = false;
17.     protected $keyType = 'string';
18. 
19.     protected $fillable = [
20.         'id_user',
21.         'name',
22.         'email',
23.         'password',
24.         'role'
25.     ];
26. 
27.     protected $hidden = [
28.         'password',
29.         'remember_token',
30.     ];
31. 
32.     protected static function boot()
33.     {
34.         parent::boot();
35. 
36.         static::creating(function ($user) {
37.             if (!$user->id_user) {
38.                 $user->id_user = (string) Str::uuid();
39.             }
40.             // Set default role jika kosong
41.             if (!$user->role) {
42.                 $user->role = 'member';
43.             }
44.         });
45.     }
46. 
47.     /**
48.      * ✅ AUTO HASH PASSWORD (Modern Style)
49.      * Menggunakan Laravel Attribute untuk mutator yang lebih bersih.
50.      * Ini akan otomatis menghash password saat kita melakukan User::create() atau $user->password = '...'
51.      */
52.     protected function password(): Attribute
53.     {
54.         return Attribute::make(
55.             set: fn ($value) => Hash::needsRehash($value) ? Hash::make($value) : $value,
56.         );
57.     }
58.

60.     |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
61.     | RBAC HELPERS

63.     */

66.     {

68.     }

71.     {
72.         return in_array($this->role, (array) $roles);
73.     }
74.

76.     |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
77.     | RELATIONS
78.     |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
79.     */
80.
```

```
212. function editExpense(exp) {
213.     document.getElementById('nama_pengeluaran').value = exp.nama_pengeluaran;
214.     document.getElementById('kategori').value = exp.id_expense_category;
215.     document.getElementById('nominal').value = exp.nominal;
216.     document.getElementById('qty').value = exp.qty;
217.     document.getElementById('rekening').value = exp.nomor_rekening;
218. 
219.     document.getElementById('expenseForm').action = `/expenses/${exp.id}`;
220. 
221.     if (!document.getElementById('methodInput')) {
222.         let input = document.createElement('input');
223.         input.type = 'hidden';
224.         input.name = '_method';
225.         input.value = 'PUT';
226.         input.id = 'methodInput';
227.         document.getElementById('expenseForm').appendChild(input);
228.     }
229. 
230.     document.getElementById('submitBtn').innerText = 'Update';
231.     document.getElementById('submitBtn').classList.replace('btn-success', 'btn-warning');
232. 
233.     document.getElementById('cancelBtn').style.display = 'block';
234. }
235. 
236. // RESET
237. document.getElementById('cancelBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
238.     document.getElementById('expenseForm').reset();
239.     document.getElementById('expenseForm').action = `/events/{{ $eventId }}/expenses`;
240.

243. 
244.     document.getElementById('submitBtn').innerText = 'Tambah';
245.     document.getElementById('submitBtn').classList.replace('btn-warning', 'btn-success');
246. 
247.     document.getElementById('cancelBtn').style.display = 'none';
248. });
```

<details>

```
1. <?php
2. 
3. namespace App\Http\Middleware;
4. 
5. use Closure;
6. use Illuminate\Http\Request;
7. 
8. class RoleMiddleware
9. {
10.     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, ...$roles)
11.     {
12.         $user = $request->user();
13. 
14.         if (!$user || !in_array($user->role, $roles)) {
15.             return response()->json([
16.                 'message' => 'Forbidden - insufficient role'
17.             ], 403);
18.         }
19. 
20.         return $next($request);
21.     }
22. }
```

</details>

<sub>⏱️ 5m 7s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Intinya, **Aplin ini adalah aplikasi manajemen organisasi dan event**. Fokus utamanya bukan sekadar daftar acara, tapi alur kerja lengkap: **organisasi → event → panitia/divisi → task → budget/pengeluaran → partner/sponsorship**.

**Konsep logikanya begini:**
- **User login** dulu, lalu masuk ke **organization** yang dia ikuti.
- Di dalam organization, user bisa **buat event**.
- Saat event dibuat, sistem otomatis bikin **committee/panitia** untuk creator.
- Event punya **divisi** dan **task** yang dikelola model **kanban**: `todo → progress → done`.
- Event juga punya **anggaran** dan **expense report**:
  - budget = rencana biaya
  - expense = realisasi biaya
  - progress event dihitung dari jumlah task selesai
  - sisa dana dihitung dari budget dikurangi expense
- Ada juga modul **partner** untuk sponsor/medpar/comrel, walau lebih terlihat di API daripada web.

**Struktur role-nya:**
- Di level organization ada role seperti **super_admin / member**.
- Di level event ada **committee** dengan divisi dan jabatan.
- Akses tertentu dibatasi: misalnya invite member organisasi hanya untuk super admin, task/event tertentu hanya untuk panitia/admin.

**Alur data utamanya:**
1. User dibuat dan masuk ke organisasi.
2. Organization punya member lewat tabel pivot `organization_members`.
3. Organization melahirkan `events`.
4. Event punya `event_committees`, `tasks`, `event_budgets`, dan `expense_reports`.
5. Status event, task, dan expense dipakai untuk memantau progres kerja.

**Catatan penting:**  
Secara konsep sudah jelas, tapi beberapa bagian masih campuran antara versi lama dan baru. Contohnya ada service/API yang merujuk class/helper yang belum kelihatan konsisten, dan beberapa tampilan masih mock/statis. Jadi **arsitekturnya sudah mengarah ke event management system, tapi belum sepenuhnya rapi dan seragam**.

Kalau kamu mau, saya bisa lanjut bikin **diagram alur sederhana** dari proyek ini supaya lebih gampang dipahami.

<sub>⏱️ 9m 53s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Sudah saya baca. **Minggu 2** isinya pondasi proyek: migration, model + relasi Eloquent, dan seeder dummy. **Minggu 3** isinya fitur perilaku: update status task di kanban dan upload file nota ke storage.

Sebelum mulai, langkah kerja yang akan saya lakukan adalah:
1. Cek dulu bagian proyek yang sudah ada: migration, model, seeder, controller, route, dan view yang terkait.
2. Cocokkan isi `trello.txt` dengan kondisi kode sekarang, supaya kelihatan mana yang sudah selesai dan mana yang masih kurang.
3. Rapikan struktur minggu 2 dulu: tabel database, relasi antar model, lalu seed data awal.
4. Lanjut minggu 3: logika update status task dan upload nota, termasuk alur simpan file ke folder storage.
5. Terakhir, samakan alur web/API supaya data yang masuk, tampil, dan ter-update konsisten.

Jadi urutannya: **audit dulu → bereskan fondasi minggu 2 → kerjakan fitur minggu 3**.

```
32.             }
33.         });
34.

74.
```

```
1. async function loadBoard() {
2.     const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
3. 
4.     // cek token dulu (HARUS di luar fetch)
5.     if (!token) {
6.         alert("login dulu");
7.         return;
8.     }
9. 
10.     try {
11.         const res = await fetch(`/api/events/${eventId}/board`, {
12.             headers: {
13.                 Authorization: "Bearer " + token,
14.             },
15.         });
16. 
17.         if (!res.ok) {
18.             throw new Error("Gagal ambil data");
19.         }
20. 
21.         const data = await res.json();
22. 
23.         renderColumn("todo", data.todo);
24.         renderColumn("progress", data.progress);
25.         renderColumn("done", data.done);
26.     } catch (err) {
27.         console.error(err);
28.         alert("error load board");
29.     }
30. }
31. 
32. function renderColumn(id, tasks) {
33.     const el = document.getElementById(id);
34.     el.innerHTML = "";
35. 
36.     tasks.forEach((task) => {
37.         const div = document.createElement("div");
38.         div.className = "card";
39.         div.dataset.id = task.id_task;
40.         div.innerText = task.nama_tugas;
41.         el.appendChild(div);
42.     });
43. }
44. 
45. function initDrag() {
46.     ["todo", "progress", "done"].forEach((status) => {
47.         new Sortable(document.getElementById(status), {
48.             group: "kanban",
49.             animation: 150,
50.             onEnd: async function (evt) {
51.                 const taskId = evt.item.dataset.id;
52.                 const newStatus = evt.to.id;
53. 
54.                 await updateTask(taskId, newStatus);
55.             },
56.         });
57.     });
58. }
59. 
60. async function updateTask(id, status) {
61.     const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
62. 
63.     if (!token) {
64.         alert("login dulu");
65.         return;
66.     }
67. 
68.     try {
69.         const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${id}/move`, {
70.             method: "PATCH",
71.             headers: {
72.                 "Content-Type": "application/json",
73.                 Authorization: "Bearer " + token,
74.             },
75.             body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
76.         });
77. 
78.         if (!res.ok) {
79.             throw new Error("Gagal update task");
80.         }
81.     } catch (err) {
82.         console.error(err);
83.         alert("error update task");
84.     }
85. }
86. 
87. loadBoard();
88. initDrag();
89.
```

<sub>⏱️ 12m 32s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**Audit singkat: proyek ini sudah punya pondasi event-management, tapi masih ada beberapa blocker besar yang bikin alur utamanya belum stabil.**

**Temuan paling penting**
- **Critical — Event CRUD belum sinkron dengan database.**  
  Tabel `events` pakai `id_event_category` dan `tgl_mulai`, tapi model/controller/request/view masih pakai `kategori`. Contohnya: `app\Models\Event.php`, `StoreEventRequest`, `UpdateEventRequest`, `Web\EventController`, `resources/views/events/create.blade.php`, `edit.blade.php`, `dashboard.blade.php`. Ini sangat mungkin bikin create/update event gagal.
- **Critical — role organisasi tidak konsisten.**  
  Pivot `organization_members` cuma kenal `admin_org/member`, tapi kode sering pakai `super_admin` (`OrganizationController@store`, middleware invite, `TaskController`, `routes/web.php`). Seeder juga pakai `admin_org`. Jadi akses invite/otorisasi organisasi berpotensi salah atau gagal simpan.
- **Critical — ada referensi class/method yang tidak ada.**  
  `FinanceService` pakai `FinanceReport`, `DocumentService` pakai `EventDocument` dan `Storage` tanpa import, `EventService`/`CheckEventRole` pakai `EventMemberRole`, dan `Api\TaskController` memanggil `User::isEventLeader()` yang tidak ada di `User` model. Ini rawan fatal error kalau fitur itu dipanggil.
- **High — kanban task belum nyambung penuh.**  
  `resources/js/kanban.js` tidak di-import di mana pun, jadi drag-and-drop kemungkinan tidak jalan. Selain itu file itu memanggil `/api/tasks/{id}/move`, padahal route API yang ada hanya `apiResource('tasks')` dan update task biasa.
- **High — beberapa route penting masih public.**  
  Route organisasi dan divisi (`/organizations`, `/organizations/create`, `/organizations/{id}`, `/divisions`, POST `/divisions`) tidak dilindungi `auth`. Route invite juga hanya pakai `org.role` tanpa `auth`, jadi bisa error kalau user belum login.
- **Medium — workflow finance masih setengah jalan.**  
  Schema expense sudah punya approval/reimburse field, tapi controller/resource lebih banyak CRUD sederhana; alur approve/reject/reimburse belum benar-benar dihubungkan.

**Kesimpulan:**  
Strukturnya mengarah ke aplikasi manajemen organisasi, event, task, dan finance, tapi sebelum masuk pengerjaan minggu 2–3, yang paling harus dibereskan adalah **sinkronisasi event schema**, **normalisasi role organisasi**, dan **perbaikan endpoint/JS task kanban**.

```
3. namespace App\Models;
```

```
7. 
8. class Event extends Model
9. {
10.     protected $primaryKey = 'id_event';
11.     public $incrementing = false;
12.     protected $keyType = 'string';
13. 
14.     protected $fillable = [
15.         'id_event',
16.         'id_org',
17.         'nama_event',
18.         'kategori',
19.         'tgl_mulai',
20.         'status'
21.     ];
22. 
23.     protected $appends = ['progress', 'financial_summary'];
24. 
25.     protected static function boot()
26.     {
27.         parent::boot();
28. 
29.         static::creating(function ($model) {
30.             if (!$model->id_event) {
31.                 $model->id_event = (string) Str::uuid();
32.             }
33.         });
34. 
35.         // ✅ AUTO STATUS UPDATE
36.         static::saving(function ($event) {
37.             if ($event->tgl_mulai <= now() && $event->status === 'planning') {
38.                 $event->status = 'ongoing';
39.             }
40.         });
41.     }
42. 
43.     // RELATIONS
44.     public function organization()
45.     {
46.         return $this->belongsTo(\App\Models\Organization::class, 'id_org', 'id_org');
47.     }
48. 
49.     public function committees()
50.     {
51.         return $this->hasMany(\App\Models\EventCommittee::class, 'id_event', 'id_event');
52.     }
53.     public function tasks()
54.     {
55.         return $this->hasMany(Task::class, 'id_event');
56.     }
57. 
58.     public function budgets()
59.     {
60.         return $this->hasMany(EventBudget::class, 'id_event');
61.     }
62. 
63.     public function expenses()
64.     {
65.         return $this->hasMany(ExpenseReport::class, 'id_event');
66.     }
67. 
68.     
69.     // ✅ PROGRESS
70.     public function getProgressAttribute()
71.     {
72.         $total = $this->tasks()->count();
73.         $done = $this->tasks()->where('status', 'done')->count();
74. 
75.         return $total ? round(($done / $total) * 100) : 0;
76.     }
77. 
78.     // ✅ FINANCIAL SUMMARY
79.     public function getFinancialSummaryAttribute()
80.     {
81.         $budget = $this->budgets()->sum('sub_total');
82.         $expense = $this->expenses()->sum('sub_total');
83. 
84.         return [
85.             'total_budget' => $budget,
86.             'total_expense' => $expense,
87.             'remaining' => $budget - $expense,
88.         ];
89.     }
90. }
```

<sub>⏱️ 20m 18s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**Audit finance module selesai.** Kondisinya: **expense/nota sudah mulai ada**, tapi **budget logic masih belum lengkap dan belum nyambung penuh ke UI**.

| Area | Status | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Expense CRUD web | Ada | `ExpenseController` sudah punya list, page, store, update, delete. |
| Upload nota | Ada di web | `bukti_nota` disimpan ke `storage/public/expenses`. |
| Subtotal expense | Ada | `ExpenseReport` otomatis hitung `qty * nominal`. |
| Financial summary event | Ada | `Event` sudah hitung `total_budget`, `total_expense`, `remaining`. |
| Budget management | Belum lengkap | `EventBudget` baru model/resource; belum terlihat flow CRUD web/API yang aktif. |
| Budget UI | Masih mock | `resources/views/events/partials/budget.blade.php` masih angka statis. |
| Edit expense dengan nota baru | Belum aman | Update expense belum menangani replace file nota. |
| API expense | Ada tapi sederhana | `ExpenseReportController` belum handle file upload dan approval flow. |
| Resource budget | Bermasalah | `EventBudgetResource` butuh relasi `category`, tapi model `EventBudget` belum punya relasi itu. |

**Kesimpulan praktis:** untuk tugas kamu, pondasi finance yang sudah bisa dipakai adalah **expense input + upload nota + subtotal**. Yang masih perlu dibangun nanti adalah **logika budget/remaining saldo yang benar-benar dinamis** dan **sinkronisasi UI**.

<sub>⏱️ 27m 38s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Bukan karena `php artisan serve`-nya. **`serve` cuma nyalain server**, bukan menyiapkan data/app state.

Yang paling mungkin bikin halaman **budget** dan **finance** gagal dibuka:
- **Budget bukan halaman terpisah** — dia cuma tab di `/events/{id}`.
- **Finance page** ada di `/events/{id}/expenses`, tapi route itu **butuh login** (`auth`).
- **Database belum siap**: migration/seed belum jalan, jadi data event/budget/category bisa bikin view error.
- Untuk nota gambar, nanti juga perlu `php artisan storage:link`.

Jadi sebelum buka app, biasanya yang perlu kamu pastikan cuma:
1. `php artisan migrate --seed`
2. `php artisan storage:link`
3. lalu `php artisan serve`

Kalau halaman masih gagal, biasanya penyebabnya **404/500 dari route, auth, atau data DB**, bukan dari `serve` itu sendiri.

<sub>⏱️ 29m 1s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Karena **data `users` sudah ada sebelumnya**, lalu `UserSeeder` mencoba **insert email yang sama lagi** (`admin@mail.com` dan `coord@mail.com`). Jadi MySQL menolak karena kolom email punya **unique index**.

Yang terjadi:
- `migrate` selesai: **Nothing to migrate**
- `seed` jalan
- `UserSeeder` insert user baru
- email `admin@mail.com` sudah ada → **duplicate entry**

Kalau kamu mau reset total database lalu isi ulang, pakai:

```bash
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
```

Kalau mau tetap pakai data lama, maka seedernya harus dibuat **idempotent** dulu, misalnya pakai `updateOrInsert` / `upsert`, bukan `insert` biasa.

Jadi singkatnya: **error itu bukan dari migrate, tapi dari seeder yang menambah data user duplikat**.

<sub>⏱️ 37m 10s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Karena **nilai `role` yang disimpan tidak cocok dengan enum di tabel `organization_members`**.

Di database, kolom itu cuma menerima:

- `admin_org`
- `member`

Tapi saat create organization, kode kamu menyimpan:

- `super_admin`

Jadi MySQL menolak dan muncul error **Data truncated for column 'role'**.

**Intinya:**  
`users.role` dan `organization_members.role` itu dua hal berbeda.  
`super_admin` dipakai di level user/global, sedangkan di pivot organization seharusnya pakai `admin_org`.

Kalau mau lanjut testing, yang perlu disesuaikan adalah bagian create/invite organization supaya pakai `admin_org`, bukan `super_admin`.

```
121.         ]);
122.

125.             ->contains('id_org', $request->id_org);

135.         ]);
136.

139.             'id_event' => $event->id_event,

160.             ->members()
161.             ->where('id_user', $request->id_user)
162.             ->exists();
163. 
164.         if (!$isMember) {
165.             abort(403, 'User bukan anggota organization ini');
166.         }
167.

170.             ->where('id_user', $request->id_user)

172.

175.         }
```

```
132.         $event = Event::findOrFail($task->id_event);
133. 
134.         $isCommittee = EventCommittee::where('id_event', $event->id_event)
135.             ->where('id_user', $user->id_user)
136.             ->exists();
137. 
138.         if (!$isCommittee) {
139.             abort(403);
140.         }
141. 
142.         $task->delete();
143. 
144.         return response()->json(['success' => true]);
145.     }
146. 
147. 
148.     // =========================
149.     // KANBAN VIEW
150.     // =========================
151.     public function index($eventId)
152.     {
153.         $event = Event::findOrFail($eventId);
154. 
155.         $tasks = Task::where('id_event', $eventId)->get();
156. 
157.         return view('tasks.kanban', compact('tasks', 'event'));
158.     }
159. 
160.     public function listEvent()
161.     {
162.         $user = auth()->user();
163. 
164.         // ambil event yang user ikut
165.         $events = Event::whereIn('id_event', function ($q) use ($user) {
166.             $q->select('id_event')
167.             ->from('event_committees')
168.             ->where('id_user', $user->id_user);
169.         })->get();
170. 
171.         return view('tasks.index', compact('events'));
172.     }
173. }
```

<sub>⏱️ 51m 2s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Di finance sekarang kamu bisa tes ini:

1. **Buka daftar event finance** di `/finance`, lalu pilih event yang mau dicek.
2. **Lihat ringkasan saldo** event: **Total Budget**, **Total Expense**, dan **Remaining**.
3. **Tambah expense/pengeluaran** di halaman `/events/{id}/expenses`.
4. **Upload nota/bukti bayar** saat submit expense.
5. **Edit atau hapus expense** dari daftar.
6. **Lihat budget tab** di halaman event untuk ringkasan budget dan item budget-nya.

Kalau mau test cepat: **buat organization → buat event → masuk finance → tambah expense + upload nota → lihat saldo berubah**.

<sub>⏱️ 54m 17s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Karena **`DB_DATABASE` di `.env` masih mengarah ke database `laravel`**, sementara database itu **tidak ada**. Jadi saat register, Laravel coba query ke database yang salah.

**Perbaikan:**
- buka `.env`
- ubah:
```env
DB_DATABASE=laravel
```
menjadi nama database yang benar, kemungkinan:
```env
DB_DATABASE=aplin_proyek
```

Lalu jalankan:
```bash
php artisan config:clear
```

Kalau perlu, refresh server setelah itu.

<sub>⏱️ 101m 12s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Iya, maksud temanmu **budget dan finance memang beda fungsi**.

**Bayanginnya gini:**

| Halaman | Isi | Tujuan |
|---|---|---|
| **Budget** | rencana/proposal pengeluaran | “event ini kira-kira butuh apa saja dan berapa” |
| **Finance** | realisasi uang yang benar-benar keluar | “uangnya sudah dipakai untuk apa, ada nota, reimbursement, LPJ” |

**Contoh sederhana:**
- **Budget**
  - Sewa venue: Rp 2.000.000
  - Konsumsi: Rp 1.500.000
  - Print banner: Rp 300.000

- **Finance**
  - Bayar venue: Rp 2.000.000 + upload nota
  - Beli konsumsi: Rp 1.450.000 + nota
  - Print banner: Rp 280.000 + nota
  - status reimbursement / sudah diganti / belum

Jadi yang dimaksud temanmu:
- **Budget itu proposal**
- **Finance itu LPJ + reimbursement**
- tampilannya sebaiknya **per baris/item**, bukan kartu besar-kartu besar

Kalau kamu mau, saya bisa bantu **rapikan konsep UI-nya** jadi:
1. **Budget = form proposal per item**
2. **Finance = form pengeluaran per item + upload nota**
3. **pisah pemasukan dan pengeluaran** kalau memang diperlukan.

Sudah saya rapikan.

**Sekarang konsepnya jadi begini:**
- **Budget** = **proposal/rencana** pengeluaran, tampil per baris item.

Yang saya ubah:
- Budget tab dibuat lebih seperti **proposal form + tabel item rencana**
- Finance page dibuat lebih seperti **LPJ form + tabel realisasi pengeluaran**
- Summary di Finance dipisah jadi:
  - total proposal
  - total realisasi
  - sisa anggaran
  - status reimburse

Jadi tampilannya sekarang lebih nyambung dengan alur kerja tim:
**Budget dulu buat estimasi, Finance setelah ada pengeluaran nyata dan nota.**

```
270. function editExpense(exp) {

272.     document.getElementById('kategori').value = exp.id_expense_category;
273.     document.getElementById('nominal').value = exp.nominal;

276.

281.         input.type = 'hidden';
282.         input.name = '_method';
283.         input.value = 'PUT';
284.         input.id = 'methodInput';
285.         document.getElementById('expenseForm').appendChild(input);
286.     }
287. 
288.     document.getElementById('submitBtn').innerText = 'Update';
289.     document.getElementById('submitBtn').classList.replace('btn-success', 'btn-warning');
290. 
291.     document.getElementById('cancelBtn').style.display = 'block';
292. }
293. 
294. // RESET
295. document.getElementById('cancelBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
296.     document.getElementById('expenseForm').reset();
297.     document.getElementById('expenseForm').action = `/events/{{ $eventId }}/expenses`;
298. 
299.     let method = document.getElementById('methodInput');
300.     if (method) method.remove();
301. 
302.     document.getElementById('submitBtn').innerText = 'Tambah';
303.     document.getElementById('submitBtn').classList.replace('btn-warning', 'btn-success');
304. 
305.     document.getElementById('cancelBtn').style.display = 'none';
306. });
307. 
308. // PREVIEW
309. function previewImage(src) {
310.     document.getElementById('preview-img').src = src;
311.     document.getElementById('image-preview-modal').style.display = 'flex';
312. }
313. 
314. document.getElementById('image-preview-modal').addEventListener('click', () => {
315.     document.getElementById('image-preview-modal').style.display = 'none';
316. });
317. 
318. </script>
```

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15.
```

Iya — **logic utama task management ada di `app/Http/Controllers/Web/TaskController.php`**.

Yang paling penting:
- **`updateStatus()`** → ini yang update status task saat dipindah di kanban

**drag task di UI → kirim request ke `/tasks/{id}/status` → `TaskController@updateStatus()` update database**.

```
251. 
252.     function removeMethodInput() {
253.         const methodInput = document.getElementById('task_method');
254.         if (methodInput) methodInput.remove();
255.     }
256. 
257.     function ensureMethodInput(value) {
258.         let methodInput = document.getElementById('task_method');
259.         if (!methodInput) {
260.             methodInput = document.createElement('input');
261.             methodInput.type = 'hidden';
262.             methodInput.name = '_method';
263.             methodInput.id = 'task_method';
264.             form.appendChild(methodInput);
265.         }
266.         methodInput.value = value;
267.     }
268. 
269.     function setFormValue(id, value) {
270.         const el = document.getElementById(id);
271.         if (el) el.value = value ?? '';
272.     }
273. 
274.     function resetForm() {
275.         form.reset();
276.         form.action = '/events/{{ $event->id_event }}/tasks';
277.         taskIdInput.value = '';
278.         title.textContent = 'Tambah Task';
279.         submitBtn.textContent = 'Simpan Task';
280.         removeMethodInput();
281.     }
282. 
283.     window.openCreateTaskModal = function () {
284.         resetForm();
285.         taskModal.show();
286.     };
287. 
288.     window.openEditModal = async function (taskId) {
289.         try {
290.             const response = await fetch(`/tasks/${taskId}`, {
291.                 headers: { 'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrf, 'Accept': 'application/json' }
292.             });
293. 
294.             if (!response.ok) {
295.                 alert('Gagal memuat data task.');
296.                 return;
297.             }
298. 
299.             const task = await response.json();
300. 
301.             form.action = `/tasks/${taskId}`;
302.             ensureMethodInput('PUT');
303.             taskIdInput.value = task.id_task;
304.             title.textContent = 'Edit Task';
305.             submitBtn.textContent = 'Update Task';
306. 
307.             setFormValue('task_nama_tugas', task.nama_tugas);
308.             setFormValue('task_brief', task.brief);
309.             setFormValue('task_id_divisi', task.id_divisi);
310.             setFormValue('task_priority', task.priority || 'medium');
311.             setFormValue('task_assigned_to', task.assigned_to || '');
312. 
313.             const deadline = task.deadline ? new Date(task.deadline) : null;
314.             if (deadline && !isNaN(deadline.getTime())) {
315.                 const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
316.                 const formatted = `${deadline.getFullYear()}-${pad(deadline.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(deadline.getDate())}T${pad(deadline.getHours())}:${pad(deadline.getMinutes())}`;
317.                 setFormValue('task_deadline', formatted);
318.             } else {
319.                 setFormValue('task_deadline', '');
320.             }
```

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15.
```

<sub>⏱️ 8108m 14s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Sudah saya analisis. Saat ini proyeknya **sudah kuat di core event/budget/finance/task**, tapi **masih bolong di manajemen panitia, rundown CRUD, modul partner/certificate/document, bulk user add, dan import/export finance**.

| Area | Kondisi sekarang | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Event visibility | **Belum konsisten** | Dashboard sudah filter event by committee, tapi halaman `/events` masih `Event::all()` jadi semua event muncul. |
| Committee management | **Backend ada sebagian** | `assignMember()` sudah ada, API `committees` juga ada CRUD, tapi web UI tambah/hapus committee belum ada. |
| Committees page | **Di web belum ada** | Di `events/show` cuma tab Overview/Rundown/Budget/Tasks, jadi page committee memang sudah “hilang” dari web flow. |
| Rundown | **Masih static** | `events/partials/rundown.blade.php` baru placeholder, belum CRUD. |
| Documents / Partners / Certificates | **Sebagian API/backend saja** | Ada model/service/API untuk partner/certificate/document, tapi belum ada web routes/views yang nyambung. |
| Bulk insert user | **Belum ada** | Baru single add/invite, belum bulk add ke event/organization. |
| Import/export finance | **Belum ada** | Belum terlihat package/route/controller untuk CSV/Excel import-export. |

**Urutan kerja yang saya sarankan:**
1. **Rapikan visibility event**: samakan filter event di dashboard dan `/events` supaya user cuma lihat event yang dia ikuti.
2. **Bikin committee management di dalam event/org**: tambah/hapus panitia langsung dari UI event atau organization, lalu matikan alur page committee lama.
3. **Kerjakan rundown CRUD**: ubah partial rundown yang masih dummy jadi data nyata yang bisa tambah/edit/hapus.
4. **Buat web module documents, partners, certificates**: sambungkan model/API/service yang sudah ada ke halaman web.
5. **Tambah bulk insert user**: modal bulk add ke organization dan event, plus dropdown divisi untuk event.
6. **Tambah import/export finance**: tentukan format file dulu, lalu buat import/export untuk data uang/pengeluaran.

Kalau mau, next saya bisa lanjut **audit lebih detail per modul** dan bikin **rencana implementasi teknis per poin** sebelum mulai coding.

```
22.                 // Kirim Email dengan lampiran ID Drive (atau stream konten)
23.                 Mail::to($p->email)->send(new CertificateMail($p, $failDrive->id));

27.             }
28.         }
29.     }
30. }
```

<sub>⏱️ 8109m 53s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Sudah saya audit lebih detail. Kondisi coding sekarang begini:

| Modul | Kondisi | Gap utama |
|---|---|---|
| **Event visibility** | Dashboard sudah filter event yang user ikuti (`whereHas('committees')`), tapi `/events` masih `Event::all()` | List event belum konsisten |
| **Committee management** | Add committee sudah ada di backend (`assignMember()`), tapi baru satu arah | Belum ada **remove**, belum ada UI web yang rapi |
| **Committee page** | Di web memang sudah tidak ada page khusus | Kalau mau dipindah ke organization, tinggal rapikan flow-nya saja |
| **Rundown** | Ada partial `rundown.blade.php`, tapi isinya masih statis | Belum CRUD, belum terhubung ke data nyata |
| **Document / Partner / Certificate** | Banyak yang masih API/model/service-only | Belum ada web screen yang usable; `DocumentService` juga masih refer ke model yang belum ketemu |
| **Bulk insert user** | Baru single add/invite | Belum ada bulk add event/organization + dropdown divisi |
| **Import/export finance** | Belum ada package, route, atau controller | Belum ada alur file masuk/keluar sama sekali |

**Rencana implementasi teknis per poin:**

1. **Samakan event visibility**
   - Buat query helper/scope `visibleTo($user)` di `Event`.
   - Pakai di `DashboardController`, `EventController@index`, dan kalau perlu API event list.
   - Aturan: event muncul kalau user ada di `event_committees` atau admin org.

2. **Tambah/hapus committee di event**
   - Tambah UI manager committee di detail event atau panel organization.
   - Backend: pakai `assignMember()` yang sudah ada, lalu tambah endpoint `destroyCommittee`.
   - Tambah validasi duplicate dan hak akses `admin_org` / panitia.

3. **Rundown**
   - Buat model/controller web CRUD untuk `event_rundown_items`.
   - Ganti partial statis jadi list + form add/edit/delete.
   - Relasikan ke event dan committee assignment.

4. **Document / Partner / Certificate**
   - Prioritas saya: **partners → certificates → documents**.
   - Partner: sambungkan API yang sudah ada ke web page.
   - Certificate: buat web CRUD + status/kirim.
   - Document: bereskan model yang hilang (`EventDocument`) atau ganti ke model yang benar, lalu sambungkan PDF generation.

5. **Bulk insert user**
   - Tambah modal bulk add untuk organization dan event.
   - Organization: input banyak email / pilih banyak user.
   - Event: bulk assign committee + dropdown divisi + jabatan.
   - Backend validasi duplikasi dan batch create/sync.

6. **Import/export finance**
   - Tentukan format dulu; default teknis saya sarankan **Excel (.xlsx)**.
   - Target data: `expense_reports` dulu, lalu kalau perlu `event_budgets`.
   - Tambah endpoint import/export per event supaya file selalu terfilter konteks event.

**Urutan kerjanya yang paling aman:**  
**1) event visibility → 2) committee add/remove → 3) rundown → 4) partner/certificate/document → 5) bulk insert → 6) import/export finance**.

Untuk bagian import/export, saya perlu kamu tentukan nanti mau **Excel** atau **CSV** kalau mau hasil yang paling pas, tapi secara teknis saya siap mulai dari urutan di atas.

<sub>⏱️ 8112m 39s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Siap. Audit detailnya begini:

| Modul | Kondisi sekarang | Masalah utama |
|---|---|---|
| **Event visibility** | `DashboardController` sudah filter event by committee, tapi `/events` masih `Event::all()`; API `/events` juga masih semua event | Event muncul walau user bukan bagian dari event |
| **Committee management** | `assignMember()` sudah ada, API `committees` CRUD juga ada | Belum ada UI web yang rapi untuk tambah/hapus committee |
| **Committees page** | Di web memang sudah tidak dipakai | Tinggal dipindah ke organization/event flow dan route lama dibuang kalau ada |
| **Rundown** | Ada partial `rundown.blade.php`, tapi masih statis | Belum CRUD nyata ke `event_rundown_items` |
| **Document** | Ada `DocumentService`, tapi refer ke `EventDocument` yang belum ketemu | Modul web belum siap, struktur backend masih bolong |
| **Partners** | Model + API resource + API controller ada | Belum ada web UI dan alur assign PIC/CRUD di halaman |
| **Certificates** | Model + resource ada | Belum ada web UI, generate/kirim belum nyambung |
| **Bulk add user** | Baru single add/invite | Belum ada bulk insert ke organization/event, belum ada dropdown divisi |
| **Import/export finance** | Belum ada package/route/controller | Baru nanti pakai Excel + template |

Rencana teknis per poin:

1. **Event visibility**
   - Buat scope/helper `visibleTo($user)` di `Event`.
   - Pakai scope itu di `DashboardController`, `Web\EventController@index`, dan `Api\EventController@index`.
   - Kalau perlu, batasi `show()` supaya user cuma bisa buka event yang dia ikuti.

2. **Tambah/hapus committee di event**
   - Buat UI committee di organization/event page.
   - Tambah endpoint `destroyCommittee` / remove member from event.
   - Pakai `assignMember()` yang sudah ada untuk add, lalu tambah validasi duplicate + hak akses `admin_org`/panitia.
   - Pakai dropdown divisi + jabatan saat add committee.

3. **Committees page dihapus dari web**
   - Jangan bikin page committees terpisah lagi.
   - Pindahkan semua aksi committee ke section organization/event.
   - Kalau ada route/view lama yang masih dipakai, buang saja dari web flow.

4. **Rundown**
   - Buat web CRUD untuk `event_rundown_items`.
   - Tambah form add/edit/delete di tab Rundown.
   - Sambungkan assign ke committee/ division.
   - Ganti partial statis jadi data nyata.

5. **Document / Partners / Certificates**
   - **Document**: bereskan dulu model yang hilang (`EventDocument`) atau sesuaikan `DocumentService`.
   - **Partners**: bikin web page CRUD + assign PIC + status flow.
   - **Certificates**: bikin web page listing/generate/kirim.
   - Urutannya: partners → certificates → documents.

6. **Bulk insert user**
   - Tambah modal bulk add untuk organization dan event.
   - Organization: attach banyak user sekaligus ke pivot org.
   - Event: bulk add committee dengan pilihan divisi + jabatan.
   - Pastikan duplikasi dicegah.

7. **Import/export finance**
   - Nanti pakai **Excel**.
   - Siapkan endpoint export per event.
   - Siapkan import template untuk data uang/realisasi.
   - Karena template belum ada, ini memang dikerjakan belakangan.

Urutan kerja yang paling aman: **1) event visibility → 2) committee add/remove → 3) rundown → 4) partners/certificates/documents → 5) bulk add user → 6) import/export finance**.

```
218.     public function assignMember(Request $request, $id)
219.     {
220.         $request->validate([
221.             'id_user' => 'required|exists:users,id_user',
222.             'id_divisi' => 'required|exists:divisions,id_divisi',
223.             'jabatan' => 'required|string|max:100',
224.         ]);
225. 
226.         $event = \App\Models\Event::findOrFail($id);
227. 
228.         // ❗ pastikan user yg di-assign memang dari organization event
229.         $isMember = \App\Models\Organization::find($event->id_org)
230.             ->members()
231.             ->where('id_user', $request->id_user)
232.             ->exists();
233. 
234.         if (!$isMember) {
235.             abort(403, 'User bukan anggota organization ini');
236.         }
237. 
238.         // ❗ cegah duplicate
239.         $exists = \App\Models\EventCommittee::where('id_event', $id)
240.             ->where('id_user', $request->id_user)
241.             ->exists();
242. 
243.         if ($exists) {
244.             return back()->with('error', 'User sudah ada di event');
245.         }
246. 
247.         \App\Models\EventCommittee::create([
248.             'id_event' => $id,
249.             'id_user' => $request->id_user,
250.             'id_divisi' => $request->id_divisi,
251.             'jabatan' => $request->jabatan,
252.         ]);
253. 
254.         return back()->with('success', 'Member berhasil ditambahkan');
255.     }
256.     public function destroy($id)
257. {
258.     $event = Event::findOrFail($id);
259. 
260.     $user = auth()->user();
261. 
262.     // 🔥 hanya admin org yang boleh delete
263.     $isSuperAdmin = \DB::table('organization_members')
264.         ->where('organization_id', $event->id_org)
265.         ->where('user_id', $user->id_user)
266.         ->where('role', 'admin_org')
267.         ->exists();
268. 
269.     if (!$isSuperAdmin) {
270.         abort(403, 'Tidak punya akses');
271.     }
272. 
273.     $event->delete();
274. 
275.     return redirect('/events')->with('success', 'Event berhasil dihapus');
276. }
```

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15. 
16. ## Current follow-up
17. - Task management kanban UI is being wired with add-task and drag/drop behavior so the backend task logic can be tested from the page.
```

hak akses pada saat di halaman event
yang boleh add anggota itu hanya bph saja seperti ketua, wakil ketua, sekretaris, bendahara.

<sub>⏱️ 8147m 3s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Bagus, itu jauh lebih rapi. Saran saya: **pisahkan hak akses berdasarkan 2 hal**:  
1. **struktur event** (siapa yang boleh mengatur anggota), dan  
2. **operasional event** (siapa yang boleh kerja di task, rundown, finance).

**Rekomendasi role:**

| Role | Akses |
|---|---|
| **Event creator** | Full access, termasuk tambah/hapus anggota dan setting event |
| **BPH** (ketua, wakil, sekretaris, bendahara) | Boleh **add/hapus anggota** dan mengatur event |
| **Koor** | Boleh lihat semua modul dan mengelola operasional, tapi **tidak boleh add/hapus anggota** |
| **Member biasa** | Boleh lihat rundown/tasks, dan **upload finance** saja; tidak bisa edit struktur event |

**Kenapa dibagi begitu?**  
Karena **tambah/hapus anggota** itu sifatnya keputusan struktural, jadi harus dibatasi ke creator/BPH supaya event tidak gampang kacau atau ada orang yang sembarangan mengeluarkan anggota.  
Sedangkan **koor** biasanya fokus ke pelaksanaan, jadi wajar kalau dia bisa akses banyak modul tapi tidak pegang hak rekrut/keluarkan anggota.  
**Member biasa** cukup diberi akses kerja lapangan: lihat rundown, lihat task, dan upload finance kalau memang ada bukti pengeluaran.

Kalau mau, aku bisa bantu lanjutkan ini jadi **matrix permission yang tegas** per modul: event, committee, rundown, tasks, budget, finance.

<sub>⏱️ 8148m 58s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Saya susun dulu matrix permission yang rapi supaya step implementasi berikutnya punya aturan akses yang jelas.Siap. Aku bikin **matrix permission** dulu sebagai dasar implementasi.

**Saran struktur akses:** pisahkan antara **hak struktural** dan **hak operasional**.  
Struktural = tambah/hapus anggota, ubah setting event.  
Operasional = rundown, task, finance, document, dll.

| Modul / Aksi | Creator | BPH (Ketua/Wakil/Sekretaris/Bendahara) | Koor | Member |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Lihat halaman event | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Edit info event | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Tambah/hapus committee/anggota | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Lihat rundown | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Tambah/edit/hapus rundown | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Lihat task | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Tambah/edit/hapus task | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Drag status task | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Lihat budget | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Tambah/edit budget | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Lihat finance | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Upload finance / LPJ / reimbursement | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Approve/decline finance | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Lihat documents | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Upload/edit documents | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Lihat partners | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Edit partners | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Lihat certificates | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Generate/edit certificates | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |

**Inti aturannya:**
1. **Creator** = full access.
2. **BPH** = boleh atur anggota + semua operasional.
3. **Koor** = boleh akses semua modul operasional, tapi **tidak boleh atur anggota**.
4. **Member** = hanya lihat modul utama dan **upload finance**, tanpa edit struktur.

**Saran teknis penting:**  
lebih aman kalau akses ini nanti dibuat pakai **capability/permission**, bukan cuma `jabatan` teks. Jadi nanti role-nya bisa dipetakan jadi:
- `manage_event`
- `manage_committee`
- `manage_rundown`
- `manage_task`
- `submit_finance`
- `review_finance`
- `manage_documents`
- `manage_partners`
- `manage_certificates`

Kalau mau, langkah berikutnya aku bisa ubah matrix ini jadi **aturan implementasi teknis per controller/view**.

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15. 
16. ## Current follow-up
17. - Task management kanban UI is being wired with add-task and drag/drop behavior so the backend task logic can be tested from the page.
18. 
19. ## New scope
20. 1. Filter event lists so the user only sees events they belong to.
21. 2. Add committee add/remove flow inside an event, then remove the old committees page from the web flow.
22. 3. Finish the missing web modules for document, rundown, partners, and certificates.
23. 4. Add bulk add-user flows for event and organization, including division selection where needed.
24. 5. Add import/export for financial data.
25. 
26. ## Status
27. - Step 1 (event visibility) is implemented in web list/detail access and API event list/detail access.
28. - Step 2 (committee management) is done: event detail now has a committee tab with add/remove flow, and creators keep access even if committee membership is removed.
29.
```

```
134.             'deadline'
135.         ]));
136. 
137.         return response()->json([
138.             'success' => true,
139.             'task' => $task->load('assignee')
140.         ]);
141.     }
142. 
143. 
144.     // =========================
145.     // DELETE TASK
146.     // =========================
147.     public function destroy($id)
148.     {
149.         $task = Task::findOrFail($id);
150.         $user = auth()->user();
151. 
152.         $event = Event::findOrFail($task->id_event);
153. 
154.         $isCommittee = EventCommittee::where('id_event', $event->id_event)
155.             ->where('id_user', $user->id_user)
156.             ->exists();
157. 
158.         if (!$isCommittee && !$event->isVisibleTo($user)) {
159.             abort(403);
160.         }
161. 
162.         $task->delete();
163. 
164.         return response()->json(['success' => true]);
165.     }
166. 
167. 
168.     // =========================
169.     // KANBAN VIEW
170.     // =========================
171.     public function index($eventId)
172.     {
173.         $event = Event::visibleTo(auth()->user())->with('organization.members')->findOrFail($eventId);
174. 
175.         $tasks = Task::with(['assignee', 'division'])
176.             ->where('id_event', $eventId)
177.             ->get();
178.         $divisions = Division::orderBy('nama_divisi')->get();
179.         $members = $event->organization?->members ?? collect();
180.         $user = auth()->user();
181. 
182.         $canManageTasks = DB::table('organization_members')
183.             ->where('organization_id', $event->id_org)
184.             ->where('user_id', $user->id_user)
185.             ->where('role', 'admin_org')
186.             ->exists()
187.             || EventCommittee::where('id_event', $eventId)
188.                 ->where('id_user', $user->id_user)
189.                 ->exists();
190. 
191.         return view('tasks.kanban', compact('tasks', 'event', 'divisions', 'members', 'canManageTasks'));
192.     }
193. 
194.     public function listEvent()
195.     {
196.         $user = auth()->user();
197. 
198.         // ambil event yang user ikut
199.         $events = Event::visibleTo($user)->latest()->get();
200. 
201.         return view('tasks.index', compact('events'));
202.     }
203. }
```

```
125.     }
126. 
127.     // ✅ FINANCIAL SUMMARY
128.     public function getTotalBudgetAttribute()
129.     {
130.         return (float) $this->budgets()->sum('sub_total');
131.     }
132. 
133.     public function getTotalExpenseAttribute()
134.     {
135.         return (float) $this->expenses()->sum('sub_total');
136.     }
137. 
138.     public function getRemainingBudgetAttribute()
139.     {
140.         return $this->total_budget - $this->total_expense;
141.     }
142. 
143.     public function getFinancialSummaryAttribute()
144.     {
145.         return [
146.             'total_budget' => round($this->total_budget, 2),
147.             'total_expense' => round($this->total_expense, 2),
148.             'remaining' => round($this->remaining_budget, 2),
149.         ];
150.     }
151. }
```

```
285. public function destroy($id)
286. {
287.     $event = Event::visibleTo(auth()->user())->findOrFail($id);
288.     abort_unless($event->canManageBy(auth()->user()), 403, 'Tidak punya akses');

290.     $user = auth()->user();
291. 
292.     // 🔥 hanya admin org yang boleh delete
293.     $isSuperAdmin = \DB::table('organization_members')
294.         ->where('organization_id', $event->id_org)
295.         ->where('user_id', $user->id_user)
296.         ->where('role', 'admin_org')
297.         ->exists();
298. 
299.     if (!$isSuperAdmin) {
300.         abort(403, 'Tidak punya akses');
301.     }
302. 
303.     $event->delete();
304. 
305.     return redirect('/events')->with('success', 'Event berhasil dihapus');
306. }
```

```
50.

254.             ->exists();
255.
```

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15. 
16. ## Current follow-up
17. - Task management kanban UI is being wired with add-task and drag/drop behavior so the backend task logic can be tested from the page.
18. 
19. ## New scope
20. 1. Filter event lists so the user only sees events they belong to.
21. 2. Add committee add/remove flow inside an event, then remove the old committees page from the web flow.
22. 3. Finish the missing web modules for document, rundown, partners, and certificates.
23. 4. Add bulk add-user flows for event and organization, including division selection where needed.
24. 5. Add import/export for financial data.
25. 
26. ## Status
27. - Step 1 (event visibility) is implemented in web list/detail access and API event list/detail access.
28. - Step 2 (committee management) is done: event detail now has a committee tab with add/remove flow, and creators keep access even if committee membership is removed.
29.
```

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15. 
16. ## Current follow-up
17. - Task management kanban UI is being wired with add-task and drag/drop behavior so the backend task logic can be tested from the page.
18. 
19. ## New scope
20. 1. Filter event lists so the user only sees events they belong to.
21. 2. Add committee add/remove flow inside an event, then remove the old committees page from the web flow.
22. 3. Finish the missing web modules for document, rundown, partners, and certificates.
23. 4. Add bulk add-user flows for event and organization, including division selection where needed.
24. 5. Add import/export for financial data.
25. 
26. ## Status
27. - Step 1 (event visibility) is implemented in web list/detail access and API event list/detail access.
28. - Step 2 (committee management) is done: event detail now has a committee tab with add/remove flow, and creators keep access even if committee membership is removed.
29. - Step 3 (rundown CRUD) is done: rundown now has add/edit/delete flow backed by event_rundown_items.
30.
```

```
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15. 
16. ## Current follow-up
17. - Task management kanban UI is being wired with add-task and drag/drop behavior so the backend task logic can be tested from the page.
18. 
19. ## New scope
20. 1. Filter event lists so the user only sees events they belong to.
21. 2. Add committee add/remove flow inside an event, then remove the old committees page from the web flow.
22. 3. Finish the missing web modules for document, rundown, partners, and certificates.
23. 4. Add bulk add-user flows for event and organization, including division selection where needed.
24. 5. Add import/export for financial data.
25. 
26. ## Status
27. - Step 1 (event visibility) is implemented in web list/detail access and API event list/detail access.
28. - Step 2 (committee management) is done: event detail now has a committee tab with add/remove flow, and creators keep access even if committee membership is removed.
29. - Step 3 (rundown CRUD) is done: rundown now has add/edit/delete flow backed by event_rundown_items.
30. - Step 4 (partner CRUD) is done: event detail now has a partners tab with add/edit/delete flow backed by partners.
```

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15. 
16. ## Current follow-up
17. - Task management kanban UI is being wired with add-task and drag/drop behavior so the backend task logic can be tested from the page.
18. 
19. ## New scope
20. 1. Filter event lists so the user only sees events they belong to.
21. 2. Add committee add/remove flow inside an event, then remove the old committees page from the web flow.
22. 3. Finish the missing web modules for document, rundown, partners, and certificates.
23. 4. Add bulk add-user flows for event and organization, including division selection where needed.
24. 5. Add import/export for financial data.
25. 
26. ## Status
27. - Step 1 (event visibility) is implemented in web list/detail access and API event list/detail access.
28. - Step 2 (committee management) is done: event detail now has a committee tab with add/remove flow, and creators keep access even if committee membership is removed.
29. - Step 3 (rundown CRUD) is done: rundown now has add/edit/delete flow backed by event_rundown_items.
30. - Step 4 (partner CRUD) is done: event detail now has a partners tab with add/edit/delete flow backed by partners.
31.
```

</details>

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15. 
16. ## Current follow-up
17. - Task management kanban UI is being wired with add-task and drag/drop behavior so the backend task logic can be tested from the page.
18. 
19. ## New scope
20. 1. Filter event lists so the user only sees events they belong to.
21. 2. Add committee add/remove flow inside an event, then remove the old committees page from the web flow.
22. 3. Finish the missing web modules for document, rundown, partners, and certificates.
23. 4. Add bulk add-user flows for event and organization, including division selection where needed.
24. 5. Add import/export for financial data.
25. 
26. ## Status
27. - Step 1 (event visibility) is implemented in web list/detail access and API event list/detail access.
28. - Step 2 (committee management) is done: event detail now has a committee tab with add/remove flow, and creators keep access even if committee membership is removed.
29. - Step 3 (rundown CRUD) is done: rundown now has add/edit/delete flow backed by event_rundown_items.
30. - Step 4 (partner CRUD) is done: event detail now has a partners tab with add/edit/delete flow backed by partners.
31.
```

</details>

```
99.     public function scopeVisibleTo($query, $user)
100.     {
101.         $userId = $user instanceof User ? $user->id_user : $user;
102. 
103.         return $query->where(function ($eventQuery) use ($userId) {
104.             $eventQuery->where('id_creator', $userId)
105.                 ->orWhereHas('committees', function ($committeeQuery) use ($userId) {
106.                     $committeeQuery->where('id_user', $userId);
107.                 });
108.         });
109.     }

111.     public function isVisibleTo($user): bool
112.     {
113.         $userId = $user instanceof User ? $user->id_user : $user;
114. 
115.         return $this->id_creator === $userId
116.             || $this->committees()->where('id_user', $userId)->exists();
117.     }
118. 
119.     public function canManageBy($user): bool
120.     {
121.         return $this->isVisibleTo($user);
122.     }

124.     public function canManageCommitteeBy($user): bool
125.     {
126.         $userId = $user instanceof User ? $user->id_user : $user;
127. 
128.         return $this->id_creator === $userId;
129.     }
130. 
131.     public function canManageRundownBy($user): bool
132.     {
133.         $userId = $user instanceof User ? $user->id_user : $user;
134. 
135.         if ($this->id_creator === $userId) {
136.             return true;
137.         }
138. 
139.         return $this->committees()
140.             ->where('id_user', $userId)
141.             ->where('jabatan', 'koordinator')
142.             ->exists();
143.     }
144. 
145.     public function canManagePartnerBy($user): bool
146.     {
147.         return $this->canManageRundownBy($user);
148.     }
149. 
150.     public function canManageCertificateBy($user): bool
151.     {
152.         $userId = $user instanceof User ? $user->id_user : $user;
153. 
154.         if ($this->id_creator === $userId) {
155.             return true;
156.         }
157. 
158.         return $this->committees()
159.             ->where('id_user', $userId)
160.             ->get()
161.             ->contains(function ($committee) {
162.                 $role = Str::lower(trim($committee->jabatan ?? ''));
163. 
164.                 return in_array($role, [
165.                     'koordinator',
166.                     'ketua',
167.                     'wakil ketua',
168.                     'sekretaris',
169.                     'bendahara',
170.                     'ketua acara',
171.                 ], true);
172.             });
173.     }
```

<sub>⏱️ 8246m 8s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Iya, **`file_url` itu sekarang cuma untuk menyimpan link/path file**, bukan upload file langsung.

Jadi alurnya sekarang:
- kamu isi **URL** file, misalnya dari Drive / storage / hasil upload manual
- sistem menyimpan teks link itu ke database
- lalu tombol **Buka File** tinggal mengarah ke link tersebut

Kalau kamu mau benar-benar **upload file dari laptop** ke sistem, itu beda lagi:
- form harus pakai `type="file"`
- controller harus simpan file ke storage
- database tetap simpan path hasil upload, bukan URL manual

Kalau mau, aku bisa ubah modul **documents / certificates / partners** supaya benar-benar **upload file**, bukan isi URL.

```
112. 
113.         // optional: delete file juga
114.         if ($expense->bukti_nota_path) {
115.             \Storage::disk('public')->delete($expense->bukti_nota_path);
116.         }
117. 
118.         $expense->delete();
119. 
120.         return back()->with('success', 'Expense deleted');
121.     }
122. }
123.
```

```
1. # UI Budget & Finance
2. 
3. ## Problem
4. The budget and finance screens need clearer separation: budget should read as a proposal/planning page, while finance should read as a realized LPJ/reimbursement page.
5. 
6. ## Approach
7. 1. Rework the budget tab into a proposal-style layout with a simple input row and a table/list of planned items.
8. 2. Rework the finance page into an LPJ/reimbursement layout with explicit summary cards and an expense list.
9. 3. Keep the existing data flow and only reshape the presentation so the current backend still works.
10. 
11. ## Notes
12. - Budget = planned costs for the event.
13. - Finance = actual spending, receipt upload, and reimbursement tracking.
14. - Keep the UI compact and row-based instead of large static cards.
15. 
16. ## Current follow-up
17. - Task management kanban UI is being wired with add-task and drag/drop behavior so the backend task logic can be tested from the page.
18. 
19. ## New scope
20. 1. Filter event lists so the user only sees events they belong to.
21. 2. Add committee add/remove flow inside an event, then remove the old committees page from the web flow.
22. 3. Finish the missing web modules for document, rundown, partners, and certificates.
23. 4. Add bulk add-user flows for event and organization, including division selection where needed.
24. 5. Add import/export for financial data.
25. 
26. ## Status
27. - Step 1 (event visibility) is implemented in web list/detail access and API event list/detail access.
28. - Step 2 (committee management) is done: event detail now has a committee tab with add/remove flow, and creators keep access even if committee membership is removed.
29. - Step 3 (rundown CRUD) is done: rundown now has add/edit/delete flow backed by event_rundown_items.
30. - Step 4 (partner CRUD) is done: event detail now has a partners tab with add/edit/delete flow backed by partners.
31. - Step 5 (certificate module) is done: event detail now has a certificates tab and the sidebar routes to a global certificates page.
32. - Step 6 (documents module) is done: event detail now has a documents tab and the sidebar routes to a global documents page.
33.
```

</details>

```
333.     public function assignMembersBulk(Request $request, $id)
334.     {
335.         $request->validate([
336.             'id_users' => 'required|array|min:1',
337.             'id_users.*' => 'required|exists:users,id_user',
338.             'id_divisi' => 'required|exists:divisions,id_divisi',
339.             'jabatan' => 'required|string|max:100',
340.         ]);
341. 
342.         $event = Event::visibleTo(auth()->user())->findOrFail($id);
343.         abort_unless($event->canManageBy(auth()->user()), 403, 'Tidak punya akses');
344. 
345.         $selectedUserIds = collect($request->id_users)->unique()->values();
346.         $added = [];
347.         $already = [];
348.         $notMember = [];
349. 
350.         foreach ($selectedUserIds as $userId) {
351.             $isMember = $event->organization
352.                 ->members()
353.                 ->where('users.id_user', $userId)
354.                 ->exists();
355. 
356.             if (!$isMember) {
357.                 $notMember[] = $userId;
358.                 continue;
359.             }
360. 
361.             $exists = EventCommittee::where('id_event', $event->id_event)
362.                 ->where('id_user', $userId)
363.                 ->exists();
364. 
365.             if ($exists) {
366.                 $already[] = $userId;
367.                 continue;
368.             }
369. 
370.             EventCommittee::create([
371.                 'id_event' => $event->id_event,
372.                 'id_user' => $userId,
373.                 'id_divisi' => $request->id_divisi,
374.                 'jabatan' => $request->jabatan,
375.             ]);
376. 
377.             $added[] = $userId;
378.         }
379. 
380.         if (count($added) === 0) {
381.             return back()->with('error', 'Tidak ada member yang berhasil ditambahkan.');
382.         }
383. 
384.         return back()->with('success', 'Berhasil menambahkan ' . count($added) . ' member ke committee.');
385.     }
```

<sub>⏱️ 24165m 20s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Secara status, proyek ini sudah masuk **fase finishing dan automasi**, bukan core feature lagi.

| Area | Kondisi sekarang | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Sidebar / routing | Sudah beres | Link ke modul utama sudah jalan |
| Event access | Sudah matang | Visibility, creator access, committee flow sudah dibikin |
| Rundown | Sudah ada flow lanjut | Catatan temanmu bilang sudah Excel import/export |
| Partners | Sudah ada web page + event tab | CRUD event-scoped dan global list sudah ada |
| Documents | Sudah ada tab + global page | Tapi di kode yang saya lihat masih CRUD data/file link, belum generator template final |
| Certificates | Sudah ada tab + global page | Masih belum jadi versi final yang styling-nya rapi dan QR-nya mengarah ke halaman verifikasi sertifikat |
| Bulk add user | Sudah ada | Organization bulk invite dan event bulk committee sudah mulai jalan |
| Finance | Sudah ada import/export | Di implementasi yang saya lihat masih CSV |
| Blast email | Masih belum aman | Catatan temanmu benar: kalau masih pakai akun pribadi, itu harus dipindah ke env khusus |

**Kesimpulan:**  
Kalau mengikuti catatan temanmu, proyek sudah sampai tahap **feature completion + polishing**. Yang paling belum final itu:
1. **Document generation** sesuai template.
2. **Certificate generation** yang benar-benar final: styling, background reuse, dan QR ke halaman verifikasi.
3. **Bulk recipient certificate** dari Excel.
4. **Blast email** yang sudah pindah ke config/env, bukan kredensial pribadi.

Jadi secara umum, **fondasi sistemnya sudah jadi**, tinggal **otomasi output dokumen + sertifikat + email** yang masih perlu dirapikan.

```
        $event = Event::visibleTo(auth()->user())
            ->with([
                'documents.creator'
            ])
            ->findOrFail($eventId);        $documents = $event->documents;        $canManageDocument =
            $event->canManageDocumentBy(auth()->user());        return view(
            'events.documents',
            compact(
                'event',
                'documents',
                'canManageDocument'
            )
        );
    }    public function listEvent()
    {
        $events = Event::visibleTo(auth()->user())
            ->latest()
            ->get();        return view(
            'events.documents-list',
            compact('events')
        );
    }    // =====================================
    // GENERATE DOCUMENT
    // =====================================    public function generate($docId)
    {
        $service = new DocumentService();        $path = $service->generate($docId);        return back()->with(
            'success',
            'Document berhasil di-generate'
        );
    }    // =====================================
    // STORE DOCUMENT
    // =====================================    public function store(Request $request, $eventId)
    {
        $event = Event::findOrFail($eventId);

        // =========================
        // SAVE FORM PAYLOAD
        // =========================

        $payload = $request->except([
            '_token',
            'title',
            'document_type',
            'status',
            'notes',
        ]);

        // =========================
        // CREATE DOCUMENT ROW
        // =========================

        $document = EventDocument::create([

            'id_event' =>
                $event->id_event,

            'document_type' =>
                $request->document_type,

            'title' =>
                $request->title,

            'status' =>
                'draft',

            'notes' =>
                $request->notes,

            'generated_payload' =>
                json_encode($payload),

            'generated_by' =>
                auth()->id(),
        ]);

        // =========================
        // AUTO GENERATE PDF
        // =========================

      $service = new \App\Services\DocumentService();

        try {
            $filePath = $service->generate(
                $document->id_document
            );

            dd($filePath);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {

            dd($e->getMessage());
        }

        $document->update([
            'file_url' => $filePath,
            'status' => 'generated',
        ]);
        return redirect()
            ->back()
            ->with(
                'success',
                'Document berhasil di-generate'
            );
    }
```
